# Linear

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Dense, keyboard-first product UI in dark and light: issue boards, issue detail, menus, settings tables; plus the public marketing site.

Captured 2026-10-17, public site measured signed out (2026-09-23); signed-in app measured from redacted page copies on the free plan (2026-10-17), owner signed in. Themes: dark, light.

Public site captured 23 September 2026; signed-in app refreshed 17 October 2026. Independent visual study, not an official Linear library.

A local HTML guide, full-page public-site screenshots, design tokens for the signed-in app in dark and light, computed styles and crops of 47 app components in every state that could be reached, redacted screenshots of the app, accessibility snapshots from the first capture, public-site computed-style evidence, editable SVG sheets, individual component SVGs and public-demo reference icons. Open `style-guide.html` to browse everything.

The study separates three systems: the signed-in app, the public marketing site, and brand assets. The app is more neutral and dense than the blue-gray public product examples. Using one palette for all three would lose that distinction.

The 2026-10-17 refresh re-read the app from its own CSS, in both themes, from redacted static copies of the signed-in pages. Every app colour that was a screenshot sample before is now a measured value; the table under Colors lists each change. The SVG redraws in `components/` and `boards/` are from the first capture and are still reconstructions; the measured crops are in `components/crops/`.

#### Official brand colors

Mercury White is #F4F5F8. Nordic Gray is displayed as #222326. The brand page's RGB prose for Nordic Gray says 35, 35, 38, which does not exactly match that hex; this package preserves the displayed hex and records the inconsistency instead of silently correcting it. Brand colors are not substitutes for UI text and surface tokens. Source: https://linear.app/brand.

Status colors (`dark.color.status.*`, `light.color.status.*`) are measured from this workspace's status menu icons. Workflows and labels are configurable, so another workspace can show different ones; pair status color with icon shape and a text label.

## Typography

9 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Berkeley Mono, Inter Variable.

### Fonts (from README.md)

The app's stacks are CSS variables: `--font-regular` is `"Inter Variable", "SF Pro Display", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Open Sans", "Helvetica Neue", "Linear Thai", sans-serif`; `--font-monospace` is `"Berkeley Mono", "SFMono Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, Courier, monospace`. Both faces are served by the app as variable fonts (@font-face weight 100 to 900).

The app's type scale is `--font-size-*`: micro 12 (Derived from `round(up, .6875rem, 2px)`), mini 12, small 13, regular 15, large 18, title3 20, title2 24, title1 36. Weights are `--font-weight-*`: light 300, normal 450, medium 500, semibold 600, bold 700. Regular text is 450, not 400.

| Role | Size / line height | Weight | Letter spacing | Where read |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Issue title | 24 / 32px | 600 | -0.16px | issue detail |
| Page title | 24 / 32px | 500 | -0.16px | settings page |
| Description heading | 19 / 28px | 600 | 0.05px | h2 in a description |
| Body | 15 / 24px | 450 | -0.1px | description paragraph (`--editor-line-height` 1.6) |
| Sidebar label | 13px | 500 | normal | sidebar item |
| Control label | 12px | 500 | normal | view tabs, small buttons |
| Caption | 12px | 450 | normal | card meta line |
| Code | 14.06 / 18.28px | 450 | -0.1px | inline code, Berkeley Mono |

These are `core.typography.*` in the tokens. The public site's type follows.

| Family | Verified use | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Inter Variable | Public UI, navigation, product examples, marketing copy and headings; login/signup CSS stack | `01-home-styles.json`, `login-styles.json` |
| Berkeley Mono | Code, technical examples, small numbered annotations | `01-home-styles.json`, `agents-styles.json`, `method-styles.json` |
| Tiempos Headline | Editorial display heading on Linear Method | `method-styles.json`: 128px / 128px, weight 400 |
| Linear Thai | Fallback name present in authentication font stack | Presence in stack only; actual Thai glyph rendering not tested |

The 2026-10-17 refresh read the signed-in app's font stacks from its CSS: `--font-regular` starts with Inter Variable and `--font-monospace` with Berkeley Mono (`core.font.family.ui`, `core.font.family.mono`). Which face renders depends on what is installed; the account's code font preference showed 12px, Regular, Default.

The public Inter stack is `"Inter Variable", "SF Pro Display", -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Open Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif`. The mono stack is `"Berkeley Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace`. Tiempos falls back to a system serif/Georgia family.

The public UI uses `font-feature-settings: "cv01", "ss03"` in many elements. Preserve these when matching letterforms. Common measured weights are 400, 510 and 590, rather than assuming all labels are conventional 500/600. Family names are CSS declarations; this inspection did not prove every glyph's final fallback face.

| Role | Size / line-height | Weight | Letter spacing | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Homepage hero | 64 / 64px | 510 | Read individual sample | Homepage H1 |
| Section heading | 48 / 48px | 510 | -1.056px | Changelog heading |
| Large closing statement | 72 / 72px | 510 | -1.584px | Homepage closing heading |
| Product-demo issue title | 20 / 26.6px | 590 | -0.24px | Embedded issue detail |
| Public body | 16 / 24px | 400 | Context dependent | Homepage |
| Navigation | 13 / 19.5px | 400 | normal | Product / Resources |
| Product sidebar | 13px, normal line-height | 510 | Context dependent | Embedded sidebar |
| Section label | 12 / 14px | 510 | Context dependent | Embedded Workspace label |
| Editorial display | 128 / 128px | 400 | normal | Linear Method |

The component redraws use 12–14px UI text and 20–24px detail titles as reconstruction choices. SVG font fallback affects appearance. Install the exact faces before judging fidelity; the package does not include font binaries. Obtain Inter from https://rsms.me/inter/, Berkeley Mono from https://usgraphics.com/products/berkeley-mono, and Tiempos Headline from https://klim.co.nz/fonts/tiempos-headline/. Inter is open-source; obtain appropriate licensing for the commercial faces. Georgia and Menlo are only preview fallbacks.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Status colours depend on the team's workflow; feedback.warning is the "At risk" health label, a muted text colour, not a warning banner (none appeared); the checkbox is invisible in the copies (script shows it on row hover), so only its 12px box was read; avatar fills are this package's grey disc, only their size and shape are Linear's.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do keep the pale filled pill for the one main action.** The header's Sign up and a single hero or plan action (Get started, Talk to sales, Watch example) are pale #E5E5E6 pills with dark text; the action beside them is a dark pill, and section links are muted text with an arrow or plus ("Learn more →", "Projects +"). See [01-home](screenshots/01-home.png), [pricing](screenshots/pricing.png) and [startups](screenshots/startups.png).
2. **Do keep color in small marks.** In the product demos, status, priority and label color sits in a small icon, dot or short health word, while issue titles, ids and row backgrounds stay white or gray. The #5E6AD2 accent appears only in demo details (the composer send button, the @mention, the billing toggle, chart fills); the site's own buttons and links in these screenshots never use it. See [01-home](screenshots/01-home.png), [enterprise](screenshots/enterprise.png), [plan](screenshots/plan.png) and [pricing](screenshots/pricing.png).
3. **Don't use one rounded rectangle for everything.** Pill actions, modestly rounded sidebar items, squared list rows and more rounded floating surfaces serve different roles. The homepage shows all four at once: the Sign up pill, the 8px selected sidebar row, flat issue rows and the floating agent panel. See [01-home](screenshots/01-home.png).
4. **Don't carry marketing scale into dense screens.** Public pages use large whitespace, narrow text measures and oversized editorial titles (64px homepage hero, 128px Tiempos on Method) that do not belong in a dense issue table. The product demos on the same pages keep 13px sidebar text and one-line issue rows. See [01-home](screenshots/01-home.png) and [method](screenshots/method.png).
5. **Don't replace mixed filled and outlined glyphs with a uniform arbitrary stroke.** The demo sidebar sets outlined glyphs (Inbox, Projects) beside filled ones (the Agent Insights bars, the solid arrow inside Initiatives) and a half-filled status circle. See [01-home](screenshots/01-home.png).
6. **Do draw focus as a 1px outline in the focus colour.** Every focus-visible state measured is `1px solid` #5E6AD2 (dark) or #6D78D5 (light), offset 2px outside buttons and -1px inside fields, with the control's own shadow unchanged. See [button-primary-focus-visible](components/crops/button-primary-focus-visible.png) and [text-field-focus-visible](components/crops/text-field-focus-visible.png).
